key_provisions_or_claims: Removes the ban on autonomous vehicles of 10,001 lbs GVWR or more and creates a testing and deployment path for heavy-duty AVs.
Staged permits (drivered testing, driverless testing, deployment) with minimum mileage: 50,000 miles light-duty, 500,000 heavy-duty.
Requires a Safety Case with each permit application.
Expands monthly reporting of disengagements, immobilizations and hard braking; aligns crash reporting with the NHTSA Standing General Order.
Adds incremental enforcement (fleet, hours or area restrictions), AV Notice of Noncompliance for peace officers, and standards for remote drivers and assistants.
annotation.summary_en: California DMV notice of proposed rulemaking amending Title 13 CCR Articles 3.7 and 3.8 on autonomous vehicle testing and deployment. It opens a path for heavy-duty autonomous trucks, adds staged permits with mileage thresholds and safety cases, expands data and incident reporting, and adds incremental enforcement and remote-operator rules. A hearing is set for June 10, 2025.
